title: love love the smell
text: love love the smell. this scent is amazing! i am a BIG fan and user of yankee candle balsam and cedar and have been looking for a similar scent in an oil. previous oils i have tried smelled chemically or off but this smells AMAZING. highly reccomend!!

product_metadata.title: Cinnamon Premium Grade Fragrance Oil - Perfume Oil - 30ml/1oz
features: 1oz glass amber bottle with an easy dispensing euro dropper (dropper inset in bottle) cap.. 1oz = 30ml

The recommended usage of this fragrance oil is for home and car diffusion; Candle & Soap manufacturing; homemade cleaning products. Not for internal use or lip balm manufacturing. This product should never be used undiluted

With more than 30 years in the industry, our IFRA certified Master Perfumer creates highly concentrated, Phthalate free, enhanced formulations for use in home and topical applications. This product is a fragrance oil and, as such, has no therapeutic value. It is intended for cosmetic and home use only.
